crossRefs.note: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”
translations.bsb: Then his father Isaac said to him, “Please come near and kiss me, my son.”
translations.kjv: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
translations.asv: And his father Isaac said unto him, Come near now, and kiss me, my son.
